owner_instruction_excerpt:
troubleshoot and fix vekl worker oci run command failures
Findings (claude-code session 2026-09-24, from OCI execution history): every vekl-worker Run Command execution SUCCEEDED; the agent polls every ~3.5-4 min and the alternate-paths probe gave up after 150 s. Separately /usr/local/bin/dial-github-recovery was missing on both rebuilt peers, so the GitHub recovery probe FAILED. Fix: batch-create and await Run Command probes for up to 480 s; oracle-recovery.yml polls the execution to a terminal state and prints OCI errors; the Oracle estate driver reinstalls the recovery helper on every pass.
